text: AC5 previously excluded contradicted lines from the counted thresholds. Review refused it against PAWL-006's own non-functional note - comprehension has a hard ceiling regardless of trail quality - and was right: a contradicted line is still a line a human must read, so excluding it made the reported changeset size false and made the gate looser in the case that should worry a reader most. Inverted to: a contradiction never makes a number smaller.
